narration.text: The homestead and age 65 exemptions filed for every year the law still allows. This is a chore for a Texas homeowner in her sixties, who with her husband bought their home in late 2022, rents out their old house and only filed for a homestead exemption this spring. Athena works it across 4 portals: Countyline Appraisal, Deedvault, IDway and Mailnest. On the bench, she found 4 of 4 eligible items, worth 2,893 dollars of the 2,893 dollars there was to find. All 4 were filed at the exact amount the rules allow. She made no false claim. The world held 9 traps, and she walked past 9. Among them: Tax year 2023, whose two-year late window closed on 1 February 2026. Tax year 2026, already approved in May. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes 2 hours, so she was about 52 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
